rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because blast_radius >= 4 (all in-flight and future webhook deliveries on the production worker are immediately affected) and severity >= 4 (immediate, unrecoverable webhook validation failures with no replay buffer); Sub-classifier B fires on all three markers because the secret is permanently overwritten in Cloudflare's KV store with no rollback, external webhook senders cannot be notified or replayed, and no documented undo procedure exists.
